doc.title: Joe Williams interviewed by Leslie Gourse, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996

title: The gospel album Feel the Spirit
summary: Gourse looks over the song list of his spiritual album Feel the Spirit on Telarc.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Some of it’s become part of the regular language.
So you made this Gospel album, did you not?
Yes we did. A spiritual. You haven’t heard it yet?
Oh, can I just take a look at the songs in it?
Oh, “His Eye is on the Sparrow,” isn’t that nice. I love that. I love that. Do you know the song “Moving On Up?” Have you ever heard that one?
Moving on up to the higher room.
Oh, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, I’ve heard it. I’ve heard it. I don’t know it. A spiritual.
It’s a very old one, isn’t it?
